build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where a ball jumps over another ball using ramps and obstacles
create_dynamic_balls: create two dynamic balls positioned at configurable base coordinates in the PHYRE scene
add_static_obstacles: add static bar obstacles and vertical walls to constrain ball movement in the scene
configure_ramps: configure angled static bar ramps at negative and positive 10 degrees for ball trajectory
set_task_relationships: set the task goal requiring two balls to be touching using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
